blocks: UNIVERSE_CONTRACT_V1, and through it all canonical ingestion

1_effective_membership.rule: announcement_date is NEVER used as effective_date
1_effective_membership.why: index changes are announced days to weeks before they take effect; treating the announcement as the effective date would place a constituent in the index before it was one, in exactly the window where the announcement itself moves the price

requires: stable security/company identifier independent of ticker
2_security_identity.rule: a ticker string is not an identity and may not be the join key

3_event_types.rule: an event the source cannot type is not silently mapped to the nearest available type; it is UNRESOLVED

4_daily_eligibility.requires: for every trading date D, a deterministic answer to 'was security X an S&P 500 constituent for session D?'
4_daily_eligibility.rule: the answer is a function of the sealed event history alone

5_time_semantics.our_convention: an index change effective PRIOR TO THE OPEN of session E means E is the FIRST session with the new membership, and E-1 is the LAST session with the old membership
5_time_semantics.requires: the source's OWN convention must be established explicitly and mapped onto ours
5_time_semantics.rule: never inferred from the announcement date, and never assumed to match ours because it looks like it does
5_time_semantics.boundary_test: every fixture must pin the last old-member session AND the first new-member session, so an off-by-one convention cannot pass

6_coverage.requires: the full intended research period with no unexplained gaps
6_coverage.rule: a gap is either explained by a sealed reason or the source is UNRESOLVED for that interval; partial coverage is never extrapolated

7_provenance.rule: the raw evidence is archived before any parsing, so a later dispute is settled against the original bytes

8_reconstructability.requires: the same raw event history must produce the same daily membership table, deterministically
8_reconstructability.test: build the daily table twice from the archived raw evidence in independent processes; the two tables must be byte-identical by digest
8_reconstructability.rule: any nondeterminism — ordering, tie-breaking, locale, hash iteration — is a defect in our builder, not a property of the source

9_contradictions.rule: where independent sources conflict on an event, the event is UNRESOLVED
9_contradictions.forbidden: silent source preference, majority voting without a frozen rule, or choosing the source that agrees with the outcome
9_contradictions.required: a conflict rule frozen BEFORE conflicts are seen; if no frozen rule covers a conflict, it stays UNRESOLVED and the affected dates are excluded rather than guessed

FATAL: backfilling the current S&P 500 constituent list over history
using price-history availability as a membership proxy
inferring membership from the vendor's data coverage
10_no_survivorship_workaround.rule: these are not degraded options to be flagged; a candidate relying on any of them is REJECTED outright

canonical_event_table.rationale: event-sourced and identity-aware, because ticker|start|end cannot express a company persisting through a security change, a ticker moving between companies, or a seat passing by corporate action

columns.entity_id: stable company/entity identifier, survives ticker and share-class change
columns.security_id: stable security identifier; distinct share classes are distinct securities
columns.ticker_at_time: the ticker as it stood at effective_time — descriptive, never a join key
columns.membership_effective_from: first session of membership under this event
columns.membership_effective_to: last session of membership; null while open
columns.event_type: one of the seven enumerated types
columns.announcement_time: nullable; recorded for provenance, NEVER used for eligibility
columns.source_record_id: identifier of the underlying source record

derived_daily_eligibility.built_by: a pure function of the sealed event table and the sealed exchange calendar
derived_daily_eligibility.rule: never hand-edited; regenerated from events and compared by digest

source_hierarchy.BEST: official or institutional point-in-time constituent history carrying effective dates and stable identifiers
source_hierarchy.GOOD: authoritative constituent-CHANGE event history from which membership can be deterministically reconstructed
source_hierarchy.ACCEPTABLE_WITH_QUALIFICATION: multiple independent historical sources reconciled under a conflict rule frozen in advance
NOT_ACCEPTABLE: a current-only encyclopedia page reconstructed backwards
an unattributed historical CSV with no provenance
source_hierarchy.note_on_secondary_use: a NOT_ACCEPTABLE source may still serve as a cross-check FIXTURE. Being useful for disagreement detection is not the same as being canonical evidence, and the two roles are never merged.

INADMISSIBLE: coverage of any particular motif, family or ticker
downstream statistical result of any kind

enforcement.rule: the canonical source is SELECTED AND SEALED before its membership table is joined to price data, outcomes or episode counts
enforcement.why: a prohibition on selecting for yield is unenforceable as a promise and enforceable as an order of operations: if the join has not happened, the choice cannot have been informed by it
enforcement.audit: the selection artifact's seal time must precede the first join, and both are recorded

classification.QUALIFIED: all ten requirements met and all fixtures reproduced exactly
classification.QUALIFIED_WITH_LIMITATIONS: requirements met over a NAMED sub-period or a NAMED event-type subset, with the excluded region stated; the limitation propagates into the universe contract rather than being absorbed
classification.UNRESOLVED: a requirement can neither be demonstrated nor refuted from available evidence — the default when in doubt
classification.REJECTED: any FATAL survivorship workaround, or a fixture contradicted on effective-date semantics

fixtures.purpose: a candidate is judged against transitions whose answers are known independently, chosen for TYPE COVERAGE and fixed before any candidate is examined

two_stage_freeze.stage_1_now: the fixture DESIGN is frozen by this artifact: which transition types must be covered, and what must be known about each
two_stage_freeze.stage_2_before_selection: the fixture INSTANCES — specific transitions with specific dates — are confirmed from independent sources and sealed in SP500_PIT_FIXTURES_V1 BEFORE any candidate source is queried
two_stage_freeze.why_split: stating a transition date from memory and freezing it as ground truth would make a wrong date the standard every candidate is judged against. The design can be frozen now because it does not depend on any date being right; the instances cannot.
two_stage_freeze.rule: no fixture instance is admissible until independently confirmed, and confirmation may not come from a candidate source

candidate_instances_UNCONFIRMED.status: PROPOSED ONLY — none of these is ground truth until stage 2 confirms it; dates here are recollected, not verified

proposed.note: TSLA addition, announced 2020-11, effective December 2020, replacing AIV — a large, heavily documented single-name addition
FB -> META, 2022, entity continuous, security continuous
TWTR removal on completion of acquisition, 2022
Alphabet GOOG/GOOGL class structure — the multi-share-class case, where one entity holds more than one index security
a Chapter 11 removal such as HTZ in 2020
to be chosen in stage 2, distinct from the M&A case

fixtures.acceptance: a candidate must reproduce EVERY confirmed fixture exactly, including the last-old-session / first-new-session boundary; one boundary miss is a systematic off-by-one, not a rounding error, and classifies the source REJECTED

sequence: seal SP500_PIT_FIXTURES_V1 with independently confirmed instances
select the canonical source under the frozen ranking and seal it
build the deterministic PIT membership event table
validate against fixtures plus random manual samples
current_step: step 1 complete on seal; nothing beyond it is authorised
not_authorised: this artifact names no candidate source, retrieves nothing, and does not begin selection
